source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Holes 1-9 follow the hole lines already on OpenStreetMap; holes 10-18 are numbered by fitting the card's lengths to tee and green pairs in a walking order (none of 10-18 is numbered on the map or the photo), so the back-nine order is a best fit, not confirmed. All 18 greens are drawn as plain ovals at the green centres: the greens were still bare (not grown in) in the 2023 photo, so their shapes could not be found by color.
unsure.17: No tee pad marked on the map; tee placed on the shore below the hole 16 green, across the water from the hole 17 green.
unsure.1: The green the map draws for hole 1 (and for hole 9) is an unusual long rectangle; kept as the map has it.
